title: Project Pele Produced-and-Delivered Fuel Milestone
summary: INL records production and delivery of Project Pele's first TRISO fuel batch to the intended demonstration site.
key_findings: The material reached the Transient Reactor Test Facility at INL.
The release identifies the Strategic Capabilities Office, Army, BWXT, DOE, and INL as collaborators.
The physical milestone remains upstream of reactor assembly and startup.
why_it_matters: Produced and delivered project material is stronger evidence than a strategy or award, but it still must not be collapsed into operating reactor performance.
ftfn_relevance: Places a physical artifact on the advanced-nuclear implementation ladder.
Defines authorization, assembly, loading, criticality, power, and testing as distinct next gates.
evidence_limits: Fuel delivery does not prove assembly, authorization, loading, criticality, or power operation.
The source does not establish safety results, mobility, cost, commercial readiness, or follow-on deployment.
